Alex C: quick Q — if org flag `force_off=true`, project-level `enable=true`, route-level canary includes 10% of users, and model-level override sets `variant=beta`, which wins? trying to finalize rollout gating for search-v2. cc @Maria L @Samir
Maria L: org `force_off` should short-circuit everything — it's intended as an emergency kill. we had a bug where route still applied because resolver checked wrong order. :grimacing:
Samir: to be explicit — resolver checks scopes from least-specific -> most-specific (org -> project -> route -> model) and later scopes override earlier for normal flags. but `force_*` flags are special: any `force_off:true` at any scope blocks downstream enables (i.e., highest priority).
Irina K: hmm, what about percent gates? if project says 50% and route says 10% which wins?
Maria L: percent gates follow the same specificity rule — most-specific scope wins, so route 10% would apply for that route. force flags still bypass.
Samir: extra nuance: canary audiences are evaluated after the boolean/variant resolution. so model-level variant assignment can be gated by route audience. example: model.variant=beta at model-scope but route audience excludes you -> you get the non-beta path.
Alex C: great. for prod rollout we want: org.force_off=false, project.enable=true, route.canary=10%, model.variant=stable by default and beta only via model override + audience. can someone drop a canonical snippet i can paste in the rollout doc?
Samir: minimal example config we use:```org:
  my_feature:
    force_off: false
project:
  enable_features:
    my_feature: true
route:
  my_route:
    canary_pct: 10
model:
  my_feature_variant: beta```Resolver behavior: `force` flags short-circuit; otherwise most-specific scope wins for booleans/percent.
Maria L: i'll open a tiny PR to add a unit test in flag-resolver and a short paragraph in runtime docs. @Irina K can you sanity-check the rollout YAML and add a smoke check to the canary pipeline?
Irina K: on it — will validate and add a quick health-check that ensures route-level audience is honored (simple user-id hashing check).
deploy-bot: reminder: changing flag resolver semantics requires a migration step for existing stored configs; coordinate with #eng-infra for a deploy window.
Alex C: thanks everyone — will wait for the PR and then mark this done. :tada:
